purpose: Teach: 健二/シェル/獣医/さようなら/ドック/アルプス/土俵/囲碁

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新スタッフの健二さん、本気で、頼もしい人やな、葵で、絶対、力に、なってくれそうやで、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Aoi — this new staff member Kenji, I'm telling you, he's genuinely reliable. He'll absolutely be there when we need him. I mean it, really.
lines.style: Warm, energetic Kansai accent. Leans forward with conviction. Builds momentum on the repetition of 本気で—each time a little louder, more assured. Gesturing openly, selling the idea without needing agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。シェル型の食器、本気で、新作メニューに、絶対、合わせていきたいですね、葵で、お客様、絶対、喜んでくださいそう、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. The shell-shaped dishware — I really want to work it into our new menu. Our customers will absolutely love it, I think. Seriously.
lines.style: Bright and engaged, matching Daichi's energy but steadier underneath. Nods with genuine interest. Clear diction on the menu concept. Soft lift at the end—collaborative, not submissive.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 店内で、ペット可エリア、本気で、検討中や、葵さん、獣医さんに、相談しようかと思てる、絶対、本気で、嬉しい計画。
lines.en: The pet-friendly area inside the shop — we're seriously considering it, Aoi. I've been thinking about consulting with a vet. It's such an exciting plan, I'm telling you.
lines.style: Animated, hand gestures painting the space. Eyes bright. Rushes slightly through the setup, slows on 'vet consult'—showing he's actually thought this through. Grins at the end like he's imagined customers' reactions.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。お客様、さようならの時、本気で、心、込めて、お見送りしましょう、葵で、絶対、おもてなしの心、伝わるはず、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. When customers say goodbye, I want us to send them off with real care in our hearts. That omotenashi spirit should reach them, shouldn't it. I really mean that.
lines.style: Quieter than before, more reflective. Soft-focused, almost gazing inward as she speaks. Hands gentle and low. The pace slows—she's not rushing to convince, she's stating what matters. Tender and deliberate.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 港の近く、船のドックを、本気で、見渡せる店、絶対、出してみたいんや、葵さん、ロマンあるで、本当に、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Near the harbour — a place where you can look out over the ship docks. I seriously want to open something like that, Aoi. There's real romance in it, you know? I mean it, absolutely.
lines.style: Eyes distant, almost dreaming. Kansai warmth lifts the pitch slightly. Slower build than the first line—he's painting a picture, not selling. Pauses on 'romance,' letting it hang. Returns with conviction on the repetition, grounded again.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。アルプス風の、本気で、洋食メニュー、葵で、絶対、出してみたいですね、本気で、本当に、お客様、絶対、喜んでくださいそう、本気で、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Yes. Alpine-style Western cuisine — that's something I'd really like us to try. Our customers would absolutely be delighted, I think. Really, genuinely.
lines.style: Mirrors Daichi's dreaming quality but grounds it in possibility. Slightly higher energy than the goodbye-line, more forward-leaning. Specific on 'Alpine,' letting the word breathe. Ends with quiet certainty, not doubt.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 相撲の土俵みたいな、本気で、円形の、お皿、葵で、絶対、出してみよか、ユニークやで、お客さん、絶対、本気で、興味、持つで、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Like a sumo ring — I'm thinking we could try making circular plates. That would be unique, Aoi. Customers would absolutely be interested in something like that, I promise you.
lines.style: Earnest intensity. Leans in on the sumo reference like he's waiting for Aoi to get it. Kansai directness comes through—no hedging. Builds on 'unique' and 'interested,' each phrase carrying real weight. Ends with a short, confident nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。囲碁愛好家のお客様、本気で、葵で、おもてなしできる、特別な、コーナー、絶対、設けたいです、本気で、本当に、絶対、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We should create a special corner where we can offer proper omotenashi to our go-playing customers. I'd really like to set that up. Seriously, I'm grateful for this chance.
lines.style: Warmth fully present. Voice settles into clarity and presence. Unhurried, each phrase deliberate. Small smile audible. Not breathless or apologetic—she's offering something she believes in. Closes with quiet dignity, gratitude genuine and unperformed.
